description.value:
The progenitor of the ‘ramjet bow’ concept, the Rocket-Singer is in essence a tweak to smart rebuild technology that adds gyrojet-style ramjets to an arrow’s core. This provides an incredible range increase, and today there’s a plethora of kits for modifying other stringed weapons with such capabilities. Yet, while modern variants of this concept have the engine ignite after being loosed normally, the Rocket-Slinger instead uses ionized beams that ignite the rounds akin to actual rockets. This gives them greater velocity than their descendents, but this speed bleeds off quickly, and they’re not exactly cheap to get nowadays.

Cost: 2,200eb (Very Expensive)

Class: Excellent Quality Crossbow • Skill: Archery • Range: Assault Rifle

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: 6 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: 0 • Attachments: Extended Magazine, Infrared Nightvision Scope, Sniping Scope • Mods: Ramjet Conversion Kit

Special Features: This weapon can only fire modified High Precision Ammunition (50eb (Costly) for 1 Arrow) that also functions as High Velocity Ammunition. When firing this weapon at a target beyond 50m/yds away, it deals 1d6 less damage (3d6). When firing this weapon at targets beyond 100m/yds away, it deals 2d6 less damage (2d6). Incompatible with Cocking Lever and Reinforced String.

Range: Assault Rifle
Pre-installed: Extended Magazine, Infrared Nightvision Scope, Sniping Scope (effects already included in these stats)
Mods: Ramjet Conversion Kit

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
